attempted_claim: Let H be separable infinite-dimensional complex Hilbert space and U(H) with strong operator Polish topology act on itself by conjugation, with orbit equivalence E_conj: u E_conj v iff exists w in U(H) with v=wuw^{-1}. Let E3 on (2^N)^N be the product of countably many copies of E0: for x=(x_n), y=(y_n) with x_n,y_n in 2^N, x E3 y iff for every n, x_n E0 y_n (eventual equality in that coordinate). Decide: is E_conj Borel reducible to E3, i.e. does there exist a Borel map f:U(H)->(2^N)^N with u E_conj v iff f(u) E3 f(v)? A complete answer is either such an explicit Borel reduction with proof, or a rigorous proof that no Borel reduction exists, e.g. via Hjorth-turbulence, generic ergodicity, or invariant-definability obstruction.
decisive_failure: No complete proof in either direction was obtained. The turbulence route stalled on unverified SOT-closure, density, local-orbit, and orbit-meagerness lemmas for unitary conjugation, and the direct Borel-reduction route stalled on coding spectral invariants into E3. Literature retrieval was unavailable, so external supporting theorems could not be sourced within the pass.
